Custom software · eCommerce

From Shopify to a store the client owns

Online retail business

OwnedThe store, code and data belong to the client
No platform rentShopify's monthly plan replaced by a system they own
Built their wayNew features no longer limited by a platform

The challenge

The business ran its online store on Shopify. Like every Shopify store, it paid a monthly platform fee and could only work the way the platform and its add-on apps allowed. The business wanted to own its store and stop renting the platform it depended on.

What we did

  • Replaced Shopify with a custom eCommerce system owned by the client
  • Built a new, fast website in React
  • Moved the store's products, customers and orders across to the new system
  • Handed over the source code so any developer can maintain it

Services:Custom Business SoftwareeCommerce DevelopmentWebsite Development

Digital marketing · Social media

Restaurant social reach up from 900 to 2.4K in six weeks

Restaurant

900 → 2.4KSocial media reach
6 weeksTo reach 2,400
2.7×Growth in reach

The challenge

The restaurant's social media was running low, reaching only around 900 people. Posting was irregular, so few potential diners were seeing the menu, specials or atmosphere.

What we did

  • Planned a regular content calendar around the menu, specials and events
  • Designed on-brand posts that show off the food and venue
  • Posted consistently at the times local diners are most active
  • Replied to comments and messages to build engagement

Services:Social Media ManagementDesigning

Digital marketing · SEO

From #13 to #1 on Google in six months

Service business

#13 → #1Main search term, top of Google
6 monthsFrom starting position to first place
MonthlyPlain-English progress reports

The challenge

The client ranked on page two of Google for the search that mattered most to their business, so most potential customers never saw them.

What we did

  • Researched the searches their buyers actually use
  • Fixed technical issues holding the site back
  • Improved page content and structure for the target search
  • Tracked rankings and reported progress every month

How we measure results

Results you can check, not vanity numbers

For custom software, success means a system the client owns, that their team actually uses, and that replaces costs they were paying every month. For marketing, it means rankings, reach and enquiries that grow, reported in plain English every month.

We agree what success looks like at the start, measure it honestly, and share the numbers with you, good or bad.

What we track

  • Subscriptions and costs replaced
  • Time saved for your team
  • Google rankings and traffic
  • Social reach and engagement
  • Enquiries, bookings and sales
